title: Significance of Zn(2+) in RyR1 for Structural Integrity and Ligand Binding: Insight from Molecular Dynamics.
authors: Taweechat, Panyakorn; Boonamnaj, Panisak; Samso, Montserrat; Sompornpisut, Pornthep
journal: The journal of physical chemistry. B
one_liner_zh: 该文用MD和DFT研究RyR1通道中Zn(2+)对结构完整性和配体结合的影响，对象为离子通道蛋白而非蛋白质-DNA互作，方法虽含物理模拟但与本课题TF-DNA结合机制无关。
abstract: Ryanodine receptor type 1 (RyR1) is a Ca(2+)-release channel central to skeletal muscle excitation-contraction (EC) coupling. RyR1's cryo-EM structures reveal a zinc-finger motif positioned within the cytoplasmic C-terminal domain (CTD). Yet, owing to limitations in cryo-EM resolution, RyR1 structures lack precision in detailing the metal coordination structure, prompting the need for an accurate model. In this study, we employed molecular dynamics (MD) simulations and the density functional theory (DFT) method to refine the binding characteristics of Zn(2+) in the zinc-finger site of the RyR1 channel. Our findings also highlight substantial conformational changes in simulations conducted in the absence of Zn(2+). Notably, we observed a loss of contact at the interface between protein domains proximal to the zinc-finger site, indicating a crucial role of Zn(2+) in maintaining structural integrity and interdomain interactions within RyR1. Furthermore, this study provides valuable insights into the modulation of ATP, Ca(2+), and caffeine binding, shedding light on the intricate relationship between Zn(2+) coordination and the dynamic behavior of RyR1. Our integrative approach combining MD simulations and DFT calculations enhances our understanding of the molecular mechanisms governing ligand binding in RyR1.
abstract_zh: 1型兰尼碱受体（Ryanodine receptor type 1, RyR1）是一种Ca(2+)释放通道，对骨骼肌兴奋-收缩（EC）偶联至关重要。RyR1的冷冻电镜结构揭示了位于细胞质C末端结构域（CTD）内的一个锌指基序。然而，由于冷冻电镜分辨率的限制，RyR1结构在金属配位细节上缺乏精确性，因此需要精确的模型。在本研究中，我们采用分子动力学（MD）模拟和密度泛函理论（DFT）方法，细化了RyR1通道锌指位点中Zn(2+)的结合特性。我们的发现还强调了在无Zn(2+)条件下进行的模拟中显著的构象变化。值得注意的是，我们观察到锌指位点附近蛋白质结构域界面处的接触丧失，表明Zn(2+)在维持RyR1结构完整性和结构域间相互作用中发挥关键作用。此外，本研究为ATP、Ca(2+)和咖啡因结合的调节提供了宝贵见解，揭示了Zn(2+)配位与RyR1动态行为之间的复杂关系。我们结合MD模拟和DFT计算的综合方法，增进了对RyR1中配体结合分子机制的理解。
